texts: good. the telling itself is fully covered — Pell as speaker, Coraline Ash as addressee, and the day-17 / Year-1 / midnight time atoms all on the telling. The lantern claim is sealed under it, so it is recorded as something Pell said rather than asserted outright, and 'a dim lantern' stays a plain lantern with 'dim' carried as its own property.

bad: 'weak mist-light' is a bare mass subject of a general claim, and the translator has no way to range over a mass kind, so it dropped the kind word itself into the doer slot and recorded one single attracting event instead of the regularity you meant; a vague quantity like 'a handful of' under a general rule has no encoding either, so the generic wording hurts twice. Give the light a definite referent so the clause becomes an ordinary happening: "Pell told Coraline Ash that the weak mist-light attracts a handful of nightmoths." That keeps the light, the attracting and the handful of nightmoths intact, at the cost of reading as this mist-light rather than mist-light at large.

bad: 'a small heap of silken threads' came out as a counting phrase — 'heap' was filed as a quantity word that is not in the translator's lexicon (so no rule can ever use it), the heap itself was never typed as a thing, and 'small' ended up attached to the threads instead of to the heap. Splitting the collection off its contents removes the trap: "Pell told Coraline Ash that a handful of nightmoths leaves silken threads, and the threads form a small heap." The 'a heap of X' shape is in principle covered, so this is partly a translator slip, but the two-clause form is exactly the shape that parsed cleanly in your next sentence.

good. all four things come out as agents of one 'form' event with the closed loop as what they form, and each is typed at top level. Two passage-level notes, neither fixable by rewording this sentence: the definites 'the lantern', 'the nightmoths' and 'the silken threads' lift those things out of Pell's reports and assert their existence as fact here, and 'in the notebook' was recorded as the place the writing happened rather than as the medium written in.
